## Change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List focused checks and their scope. Distinguish synthetic CPU tests from model evidence.

## Review

- [ ] No weights, imagery, credentials, private paths or generated environments are included.
- [ ] Numerical, preprocessing, dependency and public-contract changes are explicit.
- [ ] Applicable third-party sources and notices are retained.
- [ ] Any untested behavior or support limitation is stated.
